name: milestoned-plan-dag
description: Authoring skill (plan-author) for the milestoned-plan-dag primitive: the machine-first YAML plan format in which a plan is a DAG of verifiable milestones. Documents the full grammar — milestone identity, the depends-on DAG and its implicit-chain fallback, the mandatory check/criteria/paths contract, checkbox steps — and the validate -> resolve/render CLI workflow.
